comment.narrative: In every Central Asia country there is a designated body to set up coordination among CT agencies at national level. These agencies are in charge of cooperation with external bodies and international organizations
They remain full interested in knowing how this coordination works in the EUMS. To some extent they have taken good note that there is room for improvement in their respective countries.
